text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Mejiro Palmer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Isn't it about time to ask? Ah, but what 
if she says she's not in the mood... What 
do I do...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, momentum is key! If I just ride 
the vibe and push through—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-CLATTER-CLANK!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hot spring tiiime☆ 
Woo-hooo!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, remember that hot springs ticket 
we won in the lottery? I was kinda 
thinking, isn't it about time to use it?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Rewaaards are important☆ Let's hop on a 
local train and hit the hot springs! 
Woo-hoo!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously? OK?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, thank goodness~... You didn't just 
ignore me and say, 'Go by yourself'~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with a strangely relieved Mejiro 
Palmer, we decided to head to the hot 
springs resort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew, man... That was the absolute best 
bath ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I tend to get quite a few bruises during 
races, so this really works wonders.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I've worked hard up until 
today~!
choice_data_list: You really did great out there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you too, Trainer. You've been 
sticking right by my side through all that 
training, so you must be exhausted, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's just relax and unwind together 
today. Without worrying about a single 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Party-girl Mejiro Palmer is great, but her 
natural self is just as easy to talk to 
and wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer. I hung up the wet hot 
springs towel to dry, so use it again once 
it's dry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Want some tea? I'm pouring some 
for myself. I'll brew it and let it cool 
down a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, this conversation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't this just a regular house~!? 
Calling this a hot springs trip... this is 
literally just like being at home, right!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"My own home... It truly felt like that. 
Without a single pretentious air, it was 
simply far too comfortable..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, no, no, no~. If I just settle down 
here, I'll fit in so completely that I'll 
end up shriveling away~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we need more resort vibes! We've 
gotta hype it up way, way more~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, Mejiro Palmer began 
working up a burst of motivation that 
wasn't even necessary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, dinner... ah, no, wa-dinner is 
here☆ Fu-fuu~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look, look at this sashimi! It's 
somehow sooo... sashimi~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And then~ hot pot time, yeeeeah★ How about 
a collab, tossing in rice and udon at the 
same time~?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, as a finishing touch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant, the traditional Japanese 
inn transformed into a party venue. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. They have massage chairs 
here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The vibes here look totally insane! Wanna 
crank the massage rollers to mega-crazy 
mode and try it out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, then let's go for it! Being the 
first to dive in and have fun is the true 
party spirit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Once isn't enough, so I'll keep exchanging 
bills and feeding coins! Time for an 
insanely good massage!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Startiiiiin'!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(BZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ 
ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Ow ow ow ow! Trainer, this is 
baaaaad!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(BZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ 
ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I can see the pearly gates!!!! Escape... 
runaway escapeeeeeee!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(BZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ 
ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaagh, my yukata sash is all tangled 
up~~!! I'm so screweeeed~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the solemnity came wild revelry. And 
so, the night deepened at the hot spring 
resort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Mejiro Palmer...
